ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% high-intensity white/off-white pixels and 25% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central contiguous high-intensity white region. Low-intensity black borders concentrated at the trailing edges and terminal tips. Notable low-intensity circular clusters (dots) present: five distinct nodes on the left lobe and one large node on the mid-right lobe. Oxidative yellow-brown mottling observed on the inner-right lobe quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree angle, showing high pixel depth relative to the lobar baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations across both trailing edges. Pixel amplitude of peaks is greatest on the distal half of the left lobe. The right lobe trailing edge exhibits a more eroded, irregular topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to an upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters, roughly circular, localized on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel low-intensity linear markings (rake marks) visible on the medial portion of the left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular fragmentation and loss of trailing edge material on the distal tip of the right lobe, indicating historical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial configuration of dark circular nodes on the light-pigmented field, specifically a trapezoidal four-dot pattern on the left lobe.
